name: Almotriptan

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Serious adverse cardiac events, including acute myocardial infarction and life-threatening disturbances of cardiac rhythm ( 5.1 ) • It is strongly recommended that almotriptan tablets not be given to patients in whom unrecognized coronary artery disease (CAD) is predicted by the presence…

examples.title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of Almotriptan and Ubrogepant for the Acute Treatment of Migraine

summary: Warnings for almotriptan include serious heart problems, such as sudden heart attacks or dangerous disruptions to normal heart rhythms [3]. The label strongly advises against giving these tablets to patients suspected of having hidden coronary artery disease, which is a condition affecting blood flow to the heart [3]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests done on people—gave this drug medium scores for potential liver and heart concerns [M].
